```sql
SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT r.uuid) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS ruling_intensity
FROM main."cards" c
JOIN main."rulings" r ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE r."date" >= '2016-11-01' AND r."date" < '2016-12-01';
```
